'''Jane Pensworth''' was a Solaran writer best known for the [[A Wild World]] book series.

== Life And Work ==

Pensworth was born on 15 June 1877 and died on 11 December 1969. The extracted source identifies her as a renowned Solarian writer of the early twentieth century.

She began writing ''A Wild World'' in 1897, during the same period when Solara was testing the [[Solaran Alphabet|Sunline]] writing system in schools. The first book was published in 1901.

== A Wild World ==

''A Wild World'' made Pensworth one of the named figures in [[Solaran Literature]]. The source describes the series as famous and places its fictional setting in [[Gaia]], with stories ranging across ancient and far-future eras inside that fictional world.

This draft does not treat Gaia, elves, dragons, magic, or the events of the series as historical Avant canon. They are preserved as fictional material within Solaran literature.

== Recognition ==

The source lists Pensworth as a recipient or honoree connected to the [[National Solaran Writers Award]], but it does not give the year, awarding body, or reason for the award.
